john-curiel.text: (2021) As board vice president, on a COVID pay agreement with the teachers' union: "I just want to reiterate my appreciation for WUTA for working with the District to get this approved."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Westside teachers get COVID pay plan (2021-11-08)

notes: Little findable. The Westside board unanimously approved a Lancaster Police school-resource-officer contract on June 17, 2025 (AV Press, 2025-07-12), but no trustee is named, so it is not attributed; minutes on Simbli could not be retrieved. No positions found for Jennifer Navarro, Andrew Rowe (seated unopposed 2022) or Shameka Andre. Searches used: 8.
